name: FontsourceProvider
brief: Font provider that fetches fonts from the [fontsource](https://fontsource.org) CDN.
description: This is the default provider used by `Font.load` when no raw data is supplied.
examples:
// Restore to default (if you previously swapped it out)
TVG.Font.provider(new FontsourceProvider());

members.signature: async fetch(name: string, options?: FontsourceOptions): Promise<FontProviderResult>
